title: Qaide Tanhaai May
body:
qaid e tanhaai may dam ghutne laga hai mera
aa ke seene se lagao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
mai andhere may akeli hi na mar jaaun kahin
mujhko marne se bachao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
mai teri yaad may din raat yun tadapti hoo
jaise pinjre may koi ghayal pada ho panchi
maut ka khauf hai sannata hai veerani hai
meri imdaad ko aao baba
qaid e tanhaai may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko aadat hai tere seene pe sar rakhne ki
chain ki neend bhala kaise zameen par aaye
qaid khaane may to padti hai bala ki garmi
apni godhi may sulao baba
qaid e tanhaai may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dada ne reha kitne kiye thay qaidi
us ki poti hoo magar qaid may majboor hoo mai
naam le kar tera rone nahi deta zaalim
ab meri qaid chudao baba
qaid e tanhaai may...
<<DIVIDER>>
phupiyon ke bhi bandhe haath pas e gardan hai
wo bhala kaise meri aankhon se aansu poche
be-sahara hoo yateemi ka kada mausam hai
apni soorat to dikhao baba
qaid e tanhaai may...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad baysheer ki aati hai mujhe shaam o sahar
us ka jalta hua jhoola bhi nazar aata hai
mujhe mil jao mere marne se pehle aa kar
saath akbar ko bhi lao baba
qaid e tanhaai may...
<<DIVIDER>>
nok e naiza pe jo karte thay tilawat maula
jaane kya soch ke akhtar ye sakina ne kaha
shaam ke log hai behre ye samajh sakte nahi
in ko quran na sunao baba
qaid e tanhaai may...
author: Akhtar Hussain
